name: Undertaker
detailed_description:
After the Decension, the world cracked open.
A global earthquake shattered the crust without warning. And then, the dead began to rise. No one knows why. Some call it nature's new law and they worship it.

Out of the chaos, cults have formed twisted groups who see undeath as divine. They enslave the living, command the dead, and spread rot across the ruins of civilization.

You are the Undertaker.
Your duty is simple, yet grim:
Ensure the dead stay dead. Eradicate the cults that feed on this nightmare.
This is no longer about survival. This is about restoring the natural order — with fire, steel, and resolve.

========================================================================

Undertaker is a retro-style FPS inspired by Blood (1997).

Arm yourself with a variety of weapons — each upgradable and uniquely suited to different types of enemies.

All enemies are painstakingly hand-drawn pixel by pixel, with dynamic hit detection that allows for dismemberment of limbs and heads.

But be warned — the undead won’t stop just because they’ve lost an arm… or even a head. They’ll keep coming until they’re completely destroyed. Burning them is the fastest way to put them down for good.

Engage in fast-paced, visceral combat, where every weapon offers a distinct playstyle and tactical advantage.

short_description: The veil between life and death is shattered. Corpses walk, the earth trembles, and chaos reigns. As the Undertaker, your duty is clear return the dead to the dead by any means necessary. Inspired by classic FPS games like DOOM and Blood fast-paced action in a world gone mad.
